title: Capacity Concordance: Quarterly Dedicated Autoscale Trials & Rollout Plan
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run a focused quarterly program to validate the Dedicated autoscale policy across three pilot customer cohorts, align cost SLOs with business targets, and produce an operational rollout playbook. This initiative combines model-level routing, reserved pool elasticity, and console controls so that teams can safely enable autoscale for reserved pools without breaching latency or cost guarantees. Deliverables: trial execution, telemetry dashboards, API/console controls for pool-level autoscale, cost/SLO postmortem, and go/no-go recommendation for phased launch.
acceptance_criteria: Three pilot customers completed 4-week trial with signed data-sharing consent
Canary autoscale policy deployed to 2 dedicated pools with automated rollback on SLO breach
Telemetry surfaces per-pool p50/p95 latency, unit token cost, and autoscale actions in console
Cost/unit reduction >= 12% on trial workloads vs static reservation baseline
Ops runbook documented and on-call alerted for autoscale anomalies
milestones: 2026-01-20: Finalize pilot cohort selection and instrumentation plan
2026-02-05: Engineering PRs merged for autoscale hooks and control plane flags
2026-02-18: Dashboard prototype with per-pool KPIs in Console staging

2026-03-10: Cohort B and C trials begin (external customers)
2026-03-28: Trial retrospective, cost/SLO analysis, and rollout recommendation
success_metrics: p95 latency for reserved workloads remains <200ms under autoscale
unit cost reduction >= 15% across combined cohorts
No more than 2 customer-facing incidents attributable to autoscale during trials
Console adoption: 60% of trial customers use autoscale tuning UI at least once
risks: Autoscale oscillation during workload spikes causing transient latency degradation
Telemetry blind spots for transient KV cache warmups leading to misclassification
Economic edge cases where burst pricing exceeds baseline reserved costs
Dependency on ENG-22345 (runtime batching changes) to hit latency targets
ui_changes: Add 'Autoscale' tab on Dedicated pool detail page with enable/disable toggle
Expose autoscale guardrails: min_capacity, max_capacity, cost_threshold_percent
Visualize recent scale actions and latency impact as a timeline
Inline canary controls to target subset of traffic by tag or customer ID
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Instrumentation (Jan): implement events and dashboards; unit tests for policy engine
Phase 1 - Internal Canary (Feb): enable on low-risk internal pools, 2-week observation window
Phase 2 - Pilot Customers (Mar): three external cohorts running 4-week trials concurrently
Phase 3 - Gradual Launch (Apr+): staggered enablement by customer tier with throttled ramp-up
notes: Pilot cohort criteria: predictable request mix, existing reserved pools, willing to provide telemetry access
Pricing guardrail proposal: cap autoscale spend at +30% above baseline reserved cost unless approved
